data.name: Code
data.comment: How a program ended: its exit code ({code}, the number as the system writes it), said after "ended with".

data.name: CodeNoted
data.comment: A program's exit code and what stands for it: the signal's name (SIGKILL) or a Windows status code's hex (0xC0000005), as written.

data.name: CodeSignal
data.comment: A program's exit code and the number of the signal that ended it, where the signal has no name on every system.
